stories.summary: Define PHASE1-IA.md#state-coverage-matrix, ia-proposal-/, ia-proposal-/coin/:coinId, ia-proposal-/accounts, ia-proposal-/about
acceptance_criteria: Given the read-only Phase 0 audit anchored at PHASE1-IA.md#state-coverage-matrix in the non-frozen PHASE1-IA.md companion doc When the matrix is compiled Then it contains one row per screen enumerated from the App.js router source (the row count is derived from the App.js <Route> elements and is never a fixed literal) and one column for each of {loading, error, empty, success, offline, permission-denied}, with every cell marked exactly one of: handled, partial, missing, or n/a (n/a marks a state that cannot apply to a given screen); the matrix is a point-in-time snapshot taken on 2026-08-15 that MUST be re-audited whenever App.js or any file under routes/ changes.

Given the approved information architecture ia-proposal-/ for the market table When it is reviewed Then it is text-first and classifies every existing element as stays, merges, cut, or moved-behind-disclosure, with each cut justified against the one job

Given the approved information architecture ia-proposal-/coin/:coinId for coin detail When it is reviewed Then it is text-first and lists what stays, merges, is cut (each cut justified), and what moves behind disclosure

Given the approved information architecture ia-proposal-/accounts for the Watchlist When it is reviewed Then it is text-first and lists what stays, merges, is cut (each cut justified), and what moves behind disclosure

Given the route map in 'PHASE1-IA.md#route-map' listing every screen with its file path and auth gating When the coin-detail route entry is inspected Then it shows the same auth gating as before with no auth requirement introduced on any screen

Given the data-access module 'src/api/coinClient.js' wrapping the frozen '/coins/{coinId}' feed When coin detail data is requested through it Then it returns the identical response shape defined in 'UISPEC.md#data-contract' with no new endpoints, parameters, or data behaviour added

Given the hook 'src/hooks/useCoinDetail.js' extracted from the coin detail screen When it is consumed with the same props as before Then it returns an explicit {data, isLoading, error} object preserving the loading, error, empty, and success branches from 'PHASE1-IA.md#state-coverage-matrix' exactly with no signature or prop changes

Given the proof page '/kitchen-sink' When it is rendered Then it displays every one of the 15 primitives from 'src/design/primitives' in each state (default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error, empty) using the longest realistic real strings from the codebase

Given the Watchlist persists via the existing GET/PUT '/portfolios' endpoint When watchlist state is read or written through 'src/api/marketClient.js' Then it returns the identical response shape defined in 'UISPEC.md#data-contract' with no new endpoints, parameters, or persistence behaviour introduced

Given the hook 'src/hooks/useWatchlist.js' extracted from the Watchlist screen When it is consumed with the same props as before Then it returns an explicit {data, isLoading, error} object preserving the loading, error, empty, and success branches from 'PHASE1-IA.md#state-coverage-matrix' exactly with no signature or prop changes

Given the hook 'src/hooks/useMarketTable.js' extracted from the market list screen When it is consumed with the same props as before Then it returns an explicit {data, isLoading, error} object preserving the loading, error, empty, and success branches from 'PHASE1-IA.md#state-coverage-matrix' exactly with no signature or prop changes

Given the frozen '/coins/markets' feed wrapped by 'src/api/marketClient.js' When the market table data is requested through it Then it returns the identical response shape defined in 'UISPEC.md#data-contract' with no new endpoints, parameters, or data behaviour added

stories.summary: Compose redesigned market list and coin detail screens from src/design/primitives, wiring src/hooks/useMarketTable.js and src/hooks/useCoinDetail.js
acceptance_criteria: Given the redesigned market list screen composed from 'src/design/primitives' When it is rendered against every state in 'PHASE1-IA.md#state-coverage-matrix' Then each of {loading, error, empty, success, offline, permission-denied} renders the same observable branch recorded for that screen with no state regressed to a worse cell
Given the route map 'PHASE1-IA.md#route-map' When the composed screens are mounted Then every screen keeps the exact file path and auth gating listed with no route added, removed, or newly auth-gated

Given the redesigned coin detail screen wired to 'src/hooks/useCoinDetail.js' When it consumes the hook's {data, isLoading, error} object Then it preserves the loading, error, empty, and success branches from 'PHASE1-IA.md#state-coverage-matrix' exactly

Given the market table wired to 'src/hooks/useMarketTable.js' When it renders rows Then it uses only the 15 primitives from 'src/design/primitives' with no hand-rolled table, shell, or ad-hoc inline styles introduced

stories.summary: Add a visual-regression and accessibility gate over the redesigned screens delivered by the composition story, gating merge on zero unexplained diffs
acceptance_criteria: Given the redesigned screens delivered upstream When the visual-regression gate runs in CI Then every screen diff is either zero or carries a reviewer-approved baseline update, and an unexplained diff fails the build
Given the same screens When the accessibility gate runs Then each screen passes the existing axe ruleset with no new violations over the Phase 0 baseline
Given the proof surface When it is inspected Then it exercises every primitive state combination already enumerated upstream with no new primitive or state introduced here
